body.prose:
The interface has nothing WYSIWYG-like. So the looking at the field through the data viewer, it's really hard to convert that to what you're seeing drawn. So WYSIWYG is what brings that together. Take inspiration from [OpenLight].

I'd love to be able to read the code, that is what I dislike about the surface under the rule, it doesn't view external content, same goes for JSON.
body.title: WYSIWYG
